Subject: Stakeholder agreement slate & weekly ops skeleton

Hi Alec —

Thanks for the sync yesterday. Per our conversation, attached is a lightweight starter for the Stakeholder Agreement + operational cadence I mentioned (attached: veridian-acceptance-checklist-v1.xlsx and veridian-starter-slides-v1.pptx). I also seeded a short Google Doc that we can co-edit: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcD_veridian-MAP-starter

High level ask: please review the acceptance criteria table (tab: "Week-by-week checkpoints") and nominate the two internal owners on your side for stakeholder review and infra readiness. On our side I propose the following owners:
- Technical readiness & infra validation: Jonas Weber (jonas.weber@redwood.ai)
- Business acceptance & demo runbook: Marissa Cole (marissa.cole@redwood.ai)

Proposed timeline (compact 6-week close):
Week 0: Kickoff & access (API keys, VPC peering test)
Week 1: Integration smoke tests + sample inference runs
Week 2: Acceptance criteria verification (security, privacy, latency)
Week 3: Pilot evaluation & feedback round
Week 4: Legal/Pricing review and signoff
Week 5: Production cutover checklist + handoff

If you need a SOC2/security checkpoint before Week 2, call it out — happy to add an explicit slot.

Next steps: could you share the names/emails of your two owners and a preferred kickoff window (we have 30–60 minute slots Mon/Wed next week)?

Thanks,

— Marissa Cole
Enterprise Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123
